args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter: Retail returns logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to an article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and noting team-licence access (append ?team=<company>&seat=<name>) for the companion piece at insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion.
- Article: Apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
